Thomas George Stewart (1884–1960), was an English bowls player who competed at the Commonwealth Games.
Biography
He participated in the 1954 British Empire and Commonwealth Games at Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada in the pairs event with Edward Bateman and finished 10th.
He was a Pharmacist by trade and lived in Binfield, Berkshire.
